title: General Training Writing — Letter 26
description: Task 1 letter, 26 of 29. Write at least 150 words.

sections.title: Writing — Task 1 (letter)
sections.instructions: Write the letter in the box below. It is not auto-scored.

questions.prompt:
You would like to reduce your working hours in order to study part time. Write a letter to your boss. In your letter
explain why you want to reduce your working hours
which hours you would like to work
describe how your part-time studies would benefit your employer
Write at least 150 words.
